name: unslop
description: Finds AI slop in Claude's changes (dashes, comment blocks, comments that repeat the code, tests that assert nothing, filler phrases) and tells Claude to remove it. Shows what was unslopped.

chatStyle.title: Plain chat style
chatStyle.description: Ask Claude to write chat replies in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (about 80%), with no em or en dashes and no filler.

modelPass.title: Model check
modelPass.description: After each edit, ask the detect model about slop that rules cannot judge, such as tests that assert nothing real. One small call per edit.

detectModel.title: Detect model
detectModel.description: The model alias or id for the model check.

commentBlockLines.title: Comment block size
commentBlockLines.description: Flag a run of added comment lines this long or longer.
